title: MV Homick Racer - Arcade racing with cute rodents!

posts.author: I_LIKE_BREAD7
posts.body:
Homick Racer
SYNOPSIS
Spoiler
Run through levels, jump over obstacles, and win the Galaxy Cup!
All with cute rodents and a story! (Emphasis on "a.")
I mostly used RPG Maker for the menus and the story segments, the gameplay uses a custom plugin I wrote myself.
This is an action game, where the gameplay consists of racing in an obstacle race.
There are multiple different types of obstacles gradually introduced as you progress through the story.
Running is automatic, the only action the player takes is jumping.
Jumping right ahead of a hurdle obstacle gives a speed boost, introducing an element of risk (and strategy) to the game.
The game can be played using the mouse, keyboard or a touchscreen, so if you want to play it on a phone, you can!
The goal of the game is to become the Galaxy Cup champion, by beating 16 levels including 4 bosses.
Beating the game for the first time unlocks hard mode for a bigger challenge.
Before and after each boss level there is a short story segment.
Multiple gameplay modes:
Story mode - the main mode of the game.
Endless mode - the mode where you run alone trying to get a highscore.
Multiplayer mode - local multiplayer for up to 4 players.
There are 3 language versions you can choose from in the game: English, Japanese, and Polish.

AI DISCLAIMER
Spoiler
I used ChatGPT to speed up coding some simple custom plugins for the game, and making the translations.
I didn't use AI for anything else (the story is written entirely by myself, the art is either made by me or free assets, and the music is royalty-free.)
Even when I did use it I still checked the output thoroughly before including it in the game, and quite often modified it (or even threw it away and wrote it myself from scratch), both for the code and the translations.

posts.author: I_LIKE_BREAD7
posts.body:
Hi
@ShadowDragon
and thank you for trying the game!
I'm not sure what do you mean that the AI doesn't slow down after missing a jump?
The ai and the player characters all work according to exactly the same rules during the race, and both get their speed reset to 0 if they hit an obstacle.
Some of the ai's have higher acceleration, making them regain the speed faster, but they have a lower max speed to compensate, and they all still take the same amount of time in the hurt state where they cannot move, so they still lose speed nonetheless.
Also I don't think I understand how is double jump related here?
The rules for double jump are also exactly the same for the player and ai characters.
And the reason that 2 stars are awarded instead of 3 is because an obstacle was hit during the race (this is explained the first time the player fails to receive 3 stars in a race).
The scoring system is as follows:
3 stars - win the race without hitting a single obstacle
2 stars - win the race, but did hit at least one obstacle
1 star - came in second (except for boss levels)
0 stars - came in third or below (or second for boss levels)
This isn't directly explained, but the game does say in the introduction, that you need to get at least second place to clear a level.
I hope this explanation clears things up, and if not feel free to elaborate and I will try to clarify further

If you mean the situation when the red animation appears that is not a collision.
That's the boost you (or an opponent) gets when you jump right before an obstacle.
This is also explained in the game when you reach level 3
The collision animation and the boost animation are different.
The boost animation is as shown in the above screenshot, the collision animation is like in the image below.
As you can see, the boosting animation has the character with open eyes, a smile, and red lines on top of it, while the collision animation has spinning eyes, a frown, and a band-aid.
In the video I posted there is no obstacle collision for the player, the blue ai, and the purple ai.
Only the yellow ai is hitting obstacles in that video.
